title: A resolution designating November 2025 as "National Hospice and Palliative Care Month".
latestAction: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S8793; text: CR S8782)
summary: This resolution designates November 2025 as National Hospice and Palliative Care Month. It also encourages individuals to increase their understanding and awareness of care at the end of life.
